Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
What a productive day I'm having at work today :)

But here's another question:
If some effect deals with comparision of age between
two minions, and an Ally gets involved, how do you
determine the age of Allies? Are they all the same age
as each other, and all "younger" than Vampires?
Or is their Age equal to their Life? And if so, is it
their current life total (in case their life had been
increased) or is it their starting capacity?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Jozxyqk wrote:
>
> What a productive day I'm having at work today :)
>
> But here's another question:
> If some effect deals with comparision of age between
> two minions, and an Ally gets involved, how do you
> determine the age of Allies? Are they all the same age
> as each other, and all "younger" than Vampires?

Allies are neither younger nor older than vampires (nor the
same age).

Age, in V:TES, refers only to a measure of capacity,
and thus applies only to vampires.

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
Jozxyqk <jfeu...@eecs.tufts.edu> writes:

> But what if it somehow came up?

It wouldnt. An effect based on age would have to be ignored, because
it couldnt affect the ally (not being a younger/older whatever).

A requirement to go on age similarly couldnt work.

> my last parenthetical phrase just answered my question.
> Those always say "treat as a vampire with capacity X".
> which would be age, in those rare circumstances, yes?

No. They are only treated as vampires with capacity X for playing
cards requiring those disciplines, as per card text.
